name: Pau d Arco Lotion (4 oz. tube) - Natures Sunshine
description: Pau d Arco Lotion (4 oz. tube). The pau darco tree grows in the rain forests of Brazil. Unlike other trees in its midst, pau darco does not develop fungus growth, even though it grows in the most lush tropical rainforests in the world. Pau darco contains a chemical called lapachol, which may account for the herbs traditional use in strengthening and supporting the immune system.
